column1: # libproven C ABI status ledger. One row per symbol declared in proven.h or
# exported by libproven. proven.h is the target ABI; this file says which part
# of it actually exists. Columns are tab-separated:
# status   exported    in proven.h, exported, signature matches the header
#          conflict    exported under the header name with an incompatible signature
#          owed        in proven.h, not exported; an outstanding ABI obligation
# backend  idris-refc  computed by the compiled Idris core through RefC
#          zig-legacy  computed in Zig; not an Idris-verified implementation
# Bindings may bind only `exported` rows. Checkers fail if an exported row is
# missing from the library, an owed row appears in it, or a header symbol or
# library export has no row. Move a row only together with the code change.
# Rows describe the qualified profile: build_standalone.zig -Dheader-refc on
# native Linux x86_64 GNU. Without -Dheader-refc, proven_header_has_crlf is
# still exported but refuses with status -99 (no Idris backend).
